Khanna Police Organizes Tree Plantation Drive at Kishori lal Jethi Girls school Of Eminence
results.description: Khanna, July 31 (Amrish Anand): As part of the ongoing tree plantation campaign aimed at promoting environmental conservation and greenery, Khanna Police organized a special plantation drive at Kishori lal Jethi Girls school Of Eminence Khanna.The drive was conducted under the guidance of Special DGP (Community Affairs & Women Affairs) IPS Gurpreet Kaur Deo and the directions of SSP Khanna Dr. Darpan Ahluwalia.
